items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Jerry Bergonzi. Oh man, isn’t he bad?

ctx.x: Jerry Bergonzi. Oh man, isn’t he bad? But hear him man, boy I mean he’s playing some stuff, you know what I mean? I look at — oh thank you very much — look at Diz. Like people want to forget about him like he never existed. But —
Do you think there’s too much emphasis on something has to be new?
